title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 垃圾处理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）
meta: 主题语境：垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）　|　核心词汇：rubbish　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rubbish 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the farmer ① cleared the rubbish that no child in the field would have measured, and he said the clearing was the whole of the autumn. The ② rubbish, meaning the waste itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unmeasured in the book; rubbish, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of rubbish in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ rubbish at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Rubbish, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the farmer said the measuring is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rubbish was the whole of the matter, meaning the shame and not the waste. The ⑥ rubbish, meaning the shame and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; rubbish, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both waste and a shame. He said the shame is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ rubbish had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ rubbish of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of measuring; rubbish, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rubbish I remember is the rubbish measured in the almanac, which closed in 1994 and is still measured as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Rubbish, my mother said in 1996, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all rubbish, she said, is a shame that has agreed to look like waste. She said the shame was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 垃圾；废话（指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 垃圾；废话（指那堆垃圾本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the rubbish 清这一堆垃圾
D. n. 垃圾；废话（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 垃圾之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的垃圾之事）
F. n. 垃圾；废话（指农事历里写到、被测量的那一堆）
G. n. 垃圾、丢人（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 丢人（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the rubbish that no child in the field would have measured
The rubbish, meaning the waste itself and not the basket
Every sort of rubbish in that field
the rubbish at the far fence
the rubbish was the whole of the matter
the rubbish had become a line in an almanac
The rubbish of the whole thing

answers.why: clear the rubbish 意为“清这一堆垃圾”，1987 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯测量的一堆垃圾做了一遍。
rubbish 意为“垃圾；废话”，指那堆垃圾本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被测量。
rubbish 意为“垃圾；废话”，指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
rubbish 意为“垃圾；废话”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rubbish 意为“垃圾、丢人”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这堆丢人就是那件事的全部。
rubbish 意为“丢人”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那堆垃圾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rubbish 意为“垃圾；废话”，指农事历里写到、被测量的那一堆，到 1992 年这一堆成了农事历里的一行。
rubbish 意为“垃圾之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的垃圾之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的测量。
rubbish 意为“垃圾；废话”，我记得的是农事历里测量过的那一堆，1994 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一堆。
rubbish 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，垃圾是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的垃圾。
